name: davdunc-plugins
description: Personal Claude plugins collection for equities trading: watchlist generation, trading plans, historical market data retrieval, and DAS Trader Pro hotkey scripting.

plugins.name: market-data
plugins.description: Download historical US stock market data (minute and daily OHLCV with extended hours) from Massive.com flat files. Stores data locally for analysis.

plugins.name: dastrader
plugins.description: DAS Trader Pro hotkey, button, and routing assistant for Cobra Trading users. Writes and debugs DAS hotkey scripts, TriggerOrder brackets, CMD API commands, and risk-sizing entries.
